summary.headline: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs.2,642 Cr and business EBITDA Rs.247 Cr for One Sudarshan; FY27 guidance held pending Q2 review.
summary.overview: Management reported a strong Q1 FY27 for One Sudarshan, with revenue from operations of Rs.2,642 Cr, business EBITDA of Rs.247 Cr and reported EBITDA of Rs.266 Cr, cited as roughly 60%+ YoY EBITDA growth and about 5% revenue growth. The acquired (Heubach/Clariant pigments) group delivered business EBITDA of Rs.128 Cr versus Rs.65 Cr a year ago, while RIECO was weak with revenue of Rs.38 Cr on customer readiness and subcontractor labour issues. Net debt fell to Rs.531 Cr from a Rs.922 Cr peak. Management kept the acquired-group guidance of EUR 700 Mn turnover and EUR 35 Mn EBITDA unchanged, citing geopolitical uncertainty, and will review it after Q2.

financial_highlights.change: from Rs.78 Cr; inventory overhead impact Rs.18 Cr

financial_highlights.value: ~6% (modest growth, per Rathi), ~5% (per Rathi's acquired-group remark)
financial_highlights.change: YoY; prior-year Q1 base included only partial post-acquisition sales
management: movement of ~2% QoQ, sustained at 50%+

segments.name: Acquired group (pigments, ex-RIECO)
segments.commentary: Business EBITDA Rs.128 Cr vs Rs.65 Cr YoY; reported EBITDA Rs.146 Cr after Rs.18 Cr inventory overhead impact. Management says business margin has been consistently double-digit historically, and sees a 6-7% level as a stepping stone to high single or low double digits.

segments.name: RIECO
segments.commentary: Q1 revenue Rs.38 Cr, with EBITDA down on execution delays (customer readiness, subcontractor manpower shortages). Management expects normalisation from Q2 and a positive EBITDA before year end.

guidance_outlook: Acquired group FY27 guidance unchanged: turnover EUR 700 Mn and EBITDA EUR 35 Mn; management will revisit after Q2 despite a stronger Q1.
Legacy Sudarshan growth expected at roughly 12-13% in the near term.
Value capture and cost reduction are expected to drive most EBITDA growth, mainly in FY27-FY28, with some flowing into FY29.
FY29 consolidated targets (about 16-17% revenue CAGR at higher end and EBITDA near doubling vs FY27) are described as previously stated, not new.
Revenue of Rs.12,000 Cr+ cited as the long-term projection from the investor deck (slide 9).
Gross margin expected to stay above 50%; seasonality expected in Q3.
capex_capacity: No new capex needed for volume growth in guided numbers, per management; existing capacity is sufficient.
Possible moderate capex for backward integration or special projects, to be approved only on acceptable ROI.
Global capability centre set up in Pune; second global headquarters opened in Frankfurt.
Project Integra (One SAP) targeted to go live within FY27; currently running more than four SAP instances and 130 applications.
Management cites 55-60% of assets located in Asia.
demand_pricing: Customers delayed purchases amid geopolitical uncertainty; logistics cycle lengthened by about two weeks.
Energy, raw material and logistics costs rose in Europe and India; price increases so far passed on cost increases only, with management committing to reverse pricing if raw materials soften.

Coatings: US decorative and automotive subdued; plastics demand choppy on polymer price spikes and hand-to-mouth buying; volume printing inks declining while specialty inks, agro and digital inks grow well.
Management says a meaningful part of growth will come from recapturing business lost post-integration (lack of focus, insolvency issues), not from market growth.
Pigment pricing is contract-driven; switching pigments takes 1-2 years, up to 5 years in automotive, and pricing is generally negotiated quarterly.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the Q1 growth reflects underlying volume after FX translation and price increases; can growth be 2-2.5x industry?
qa_highlights.answer: Management disputed the volume-decline inference, citing ~6% growth and a weak prior-year Q1 base with partial post-acquisition sales. It said growth will come from winning back lost business and value capture.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the EBITDA path to FY29 is volume versus cost/value capture?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is substantially cost reduction and value capture.

qa_highlights.question: Capex needs in the next 12-18 months?
qa_highlights.answer: No volume capex needed; only moderate capex on backward integration or special projects if ROI is good.

qa_highlights.question: Is ~54% gross margin sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross margin moved about 2% QoQ on yields, utilities and production cost cuts, plus minor one-offs; management expects 50%+ to continue.

qa_highlights.question: Debt repayment plans and RIECO hive-off?
qa_highlights.answer: Some acquisition debt has been prepaid, with faster repayment planned as net debt falls. RIECO is in transformation with no hive-off mentioned; management expects a positive EBITDA before year end.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the acquired group's stake in Sudarshan Colorants held indirectly, and what is the restructuring provision after June 30?
qa_highlights.answer: The indirect holding was for financing reasons, with a plan to hold directly from the parent, so this is group restructuring with no business impact. The restructuring charge is not yet quantifiable, with clarity expected by end of Q2.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 guidance conservative given Q1 run-rate, and is 6-7% margin the steady state?
qa_highlights.answer: Management is not revising guidance until Q2 review. It does not expect 15%+ margins; the target is high single digit to low double digit.

risks_watch: Unquantified restructuring charge tied to a post-June 30 employee agreement at a European subsidiary; quantification expected by end Q2.
FY27 guidance not revised despite a strong Q1; Q2 result is the next checkpoint.
RIECO execution: revenue Rs.38 Cr and EBITDA decline in Q1; recovery depends on labour and customer readiness.
Raw material and energy volatility (Middle East crisis) and logistics delays; pricing may need reversal if raw material costs fall.
Delayed customer purchasing and subdued US/EU coatings demand.
Project Integra (One SAP) go-live and value capture delivery within FY27.
key_quotes: Though the Q1 performance has been much stronger, currently we are not revising our guidelines given the geopolitical situation.
As it was mentioned in the note, right now the quantification was not possible. By the end of Q2 I think we should have clarity on the quantification of this.
Substantially, this would come from cost reduction or value capture.
The good part is if you look at the reported and business EBITDA, we have been able to do a very good job in the acquired group.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the Q1 operating print, value capture and the balance sheet, but cautious on guidance: management held FY27 acquired-group targets and deferred any revision until the Q2 review, citing geopolitics. It was evasive on quantifying the post-June 30 restructuring charge and on how much of the FY29 EBITDA path is volume versus cost, and it gave no margin target beyond high single digit to low double digit.
